title: Eames Lounge Chair
blurb: A moulded plywood and leather armchair from 1956, designed to feel like a well-used baseball mitt.

title: Lava lamp
blurb: Blobs of coloured wax rising and sinking through liquid in a glowing glass vessel, since 1963.

title: Anglepoise lamp
blurb: A desk lamp balanced on springs so that it stays wherever you point it.

title: Moka pot
blurb: The eight-sided aluminium stovetop coffee maker found in nearly every Italian kitchen.

title: Music box
blurb: A box that plays a tune when a pinned cylinder plucks the teeth of a steel comb.

title: Heath Ceramics
about: Ceramic dinnerware made in California since 1948
blurb: Heath makes ceramic dinnerware and tiles in California, as it has since 1948, with a dinnerware factory in Sausalito and a clay studio in San Francisco.

title: East Fork
about: Handmade pottery from Asheville, North Carolina
blurb: East Fork began as one potter throwing clay and firing a wood kiln on an old tobacco farm in the Blue Ridge Mountains, and now makes ceramic dinnerware by hand in Asheville.

title: Fishs Eddy
blurb: For over 40 years Fishs Eddy has sold dishes in the spirit of sturdy restaurant-ware, from its New York stores.

title: Schoolhouse
blurb: Schoolhouse began when it found vintage lighting molds in an old upstate New York factory, and reimagines traditional forms for the home.

title: Ellementry
blurb: Handmade home décor, kitchenware, tableware, furniture and lighting from a company based in Jaipur.
